d: Bihar men kharab mausam aur barish ke karan anant sinh ki beti ki shadi ki taiyariyan prabhavit huee hain. is sanbandh men anant sinh ne midiya ke samne apni pareshani jahir ki hai. unhonne bataya ki mausam kharab hone aur kichar ki sthiti ke karan shadi samaroh ke lie mangae gae ghore kichar men nahin daur paenge aur sath hi helikoptar utarne ki bhi sanbhavna nahin hai.
